title: Key Pearl
description: Instantly throw an ender pearl with a single keybind — no hotbar switching, no cooldown reset, just fast and seamless pearl use.
body:
# 🛠️ Key Pearl
Key Pearl is a lightweight quality-of-life mod that lets you instantly throw an ender pearl using a single keybind. No hotbar switching, no slot interruption — the mod handles everything instantly so you can focus on movement and gameplay.

Designed for players who want smoother movement, faster reactions, and seamless pearl usage.

# ⚙️ Features
- ✔ Toggleable keybind (Default: R)
- ✔ Fully customizable in Controls / Keybinds
- ✔ No hotbar slot switching
- ✔ Keeps your selected item unchanged
- ✔ Instant pearl throw
- ✔ No cooldown disruption
- ✔ Clean & lightweight
- ✔ No unnecessary UI
- ✔ Fast and responsive

# 🎮 How it Works
Simply press the assigned keybind and the mod instantly throws an ender pearl without switching to the pearl slot visually.

This keeps your gameplay smooth and uninterrupted during movement, PvP, or clutch situations.

# ⚠️ Important
This is a client-side quality-of-life mod.

Always check server rules before using client-side utility mods on multiplayer servers.

Key Pearl — Instant Pearl, Zero Switching
